question: As of November 2026, what is the latest major version of Apple's iOS?
answer:
As of November 2026, the latest major version of iOS is iOS 27, and the latest release in that line is 27.2.1 [1][3]. Apple's security releases page lists 27.2.1 as the latest iOS and iPadOS version [1][7]. endoflife.date shows iOS 27 released on 14 Sep 2026, with 27.2.1 following on 09 Nov 2026 [3]. Apple's iOS 27 notes describe it as introducing Siri AI and new parental controls [2].

iOS 26 is still getting security updates, with 26.7.3 as its latest release on 09 Nov 2026 [3][4].
